items.title: Show HN: CrewCode – Open-source Mission Control for AI coding agents
items.summary: I've been experimenting heavily with coding agents and found myself managing agents more than writing code. I build CrewCode to solve that. Its an open source desktop application for running multiple AI coding agents in parallel while isolating their work with Git worktrees. Git worktrees → agent isolation → provider independence → diff review → orchestration. I'd especially appreciate feedback on the multi-agent/worktree model. I launched it on Product Hunt today and would love feedback from developers.
